pred_diagnosis: Drug Reaction with Eosinophilia and Systemic Symptoms

1: Two days after starting ciprofloxacin, he developed generalized pruritus that progressed to fluid-filled rashes.
2: Dermatologic examination showed multiple generalized vesicles and bullae with non-hemorrhagic crusts over the trunk and extremities (palms and soles spared).
Mucosal findings included hemorrhagic lip crusts and penile erosion.
